purpose: Four foundry ordinary enemy static concept sprites, no campaign replacement.
seed_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE static side-view enemy concept sprite for the pixel-art Godot game ORVASK.
Reference 1 is the approved hero: copy ONLY its broad, quiet pixel clusters, muted material colors and restrained selective contours, NOT costume or human anatomy. Reference 2 is the approved creature: use its big grouped masses and low internal detail, not its anatomy. Reference 3 is the approved environment: palette/context only; do not include architecture.
SUBJECT: the Labor Effigy, a purely mechanical humanoid foundry worker, no human flesh inside. A small round sealed dull metal mask bows down over a stooped workman's chest. Two disproportionately long hanging arms end in simple heavy work grippers. A battered dark ochre leather-like INDUSTRIAL APRON covers only the chest and upper thighs; a CLEAR HOLLOW GAP at the waist exposes two simple struts, showing that this is an empty automaton. Thick worn work boots are actually metal. One broad flat wound-spring housing on the upper back, a single large winding key/ratchet, no tiny cogs. A weary, unsettling human working posture without a face, spikes or soldier armor. Arms and two legs separated in silhouette. Distinct tall, narrow, bowed-down silhouette.
VIEW: full body, orthographic side-on with a very slight three-quarter visibility, FACE AND WALK TOWARD IMAGE LEFT. Idle standing pose, both feet share a horizontal baseline. No foreshortening, no isometric floor. Center the complete single character with at least 12% transparent space around its silhouette, no cropping.
STYLE: clearly pixel-art with chunky deliberate stepped contours, large connected color patches and quiet shadows. Apparent character resolution roughly 60–75 pixels tall, enlarged in a clean nearest-neighbor manner. Keep enough blocky anatomy to read at 110 screen pixels tall. Muted slate gray iron, dirty gray-brown apron, faded rust on one shoulder, tiny dull brass spring housing. Use subdued edges colored from the local material; no continuous jet-black outline. No glossy metal strips, no white specular shine, no texture noise, no photorealism, no airbrush blur, no dense seams, wires, rivets or tiny details.
OUTPUT: one character on a genuinely transparent RGBA background, square canvas. No ground, shadow, smoke, glow, scenery, text, words, letters, labels, title, frame or reference characters. This is a concept sprite, not an animation sheet.

Full body, orthographic side-on with slight three-quarter visibility, facing LEFT, planted feet share a flat baseline. Idle pose. One character centered on a truly transparent RGBA background. At least 10% clear margin around the whole silhouette; no cropping, no ground or cast shadow. No scenery, UI, letters, labels, words, frame, glow, particles, smoke, duplicated characters or animation sheet.

Clear large steps, apparent resolution 60–80 pixels tall, enlarged nearest-neighbor. Softer grouping comes from large patches and lower local contrast, never optical blur. Avoid tiny cogs, busy mechanisms, repeated small rivets, texture noise, dithering, shiny white edges, continuous black outlines, glossy digital painting and cute toy proportions. No flesh, skulls, horns or glowing eyes.
SUBJECT: MOLD WORKER / 금형공. A squat EXTREMELY WIDE humanoid foundry automaton, visually the heavy high-HP worker. Tiny bowed sealed round mask above a HUGE RECTANGULAR CASTING MOLD hanging as its central chest/body. The mold is weathered iron with one large recessed rectangular cavity, heavy flat surfaces, no magical shield or energy barrier. Massive body extends widely to both sides; two thick short load-bearing legs with broad flat feet. Heavy hanging clamp arms, asymmetrical shoulder block and one broad exposed wound spring/key at the upper rear. Empty frame visible only in a few large gaps. Small apron fragment may hang under the mold, not cover it. The low center of mass, huge rectangular belly and short legs MUST contrast with the tall narrow long-armed reference worker. At runtime silhouette should read around 140 pixels wide and 125 tall. Emphasize weight and a tired industrial posture, not a combat tank or futuristic armored soldier.

The wide dark bowl is a single simple shape, containing just one quiet mass of dull ash, no particles. The bowl is wider than the crouched torso.
